description: This file defines the class MAX_Admin_Invocation_Publisher, which handles generating invocation forms and codes for publishers in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for creating forms, selecting invocation plugins, and generating invocation code snippets.

classes.name: MAX_Admin_Invocation_Publisher
classes.description: A class for creating publisher invocation forms and generating invocation codes, extending MAX_Admin_Invocation.

methods.name: placeInvocationForm
methods.description: Generates an HTML form for selecting and configuring publisher invocation plugins, including options and preview.

methods.name: getDefaultOptionsList
methods.description: Returns default options for the invocation plugin, overriding parent defaults.
